name: chart-line
title: Line Chart
description: A row of dark cards each holding a line chart. One plots two series, one marks each point in a colour, and one writes values above the dots.
use: A dashboard needs small trend lines for one or two series with clear points.
avoid: Every card hardcodes its data and titles, so each variant needs editing before reuse.
a11y: The accessibility layer names the charts, but tooltip values remain pointer-only. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three bordered dark cards sit side by side with thin grey line charts on faint horizontal gridlines. The first has two crossing lines, the second a line with coloured dots, the third a dotted line with number labels over each point.
behaves: Hovering a point brings up a small tooltip with the month and series values, and the active dot grows. The labelled chart keeps its numbers above the dots at all times.
customise: Each variant hardcodes its data, title and footer; reuse means replacing those arrays and chart configs in the file.
weight: light: Three small SVG line charts with six points; no animation loop.
